body:

title: Review annotations to GO:0000717 nucleotide-excision repair, DNA duplex unwinding and related terms

author: ValWood
body:
Hi @raymond91125 it seems like we need a term for "guanine quadruplex resolver helicase" (both DNA and RNA)
this particular activity seems to be a major activity of specific helicases including the ReqQ helicases (WRN,BLM ). Pif1 family, Fanconi Anemia Helicase J, DHX36 (RHAU, G4R1) A highly specialized RNA and DNA helicase with robust G4-resolving activity, Dna2, Subunits of the TFIIH transcription/repair complex, these helicases can unwind G4 structures in the context of transcription-coupled repair. and others.

This is useful functional context to retain. I can't find another specific  term to replace  GO:0044806 G-quadruplex DNA unwinding

author: RLovering
body: I agree with Val, I had deleted our  GO:0044806 G-quadruplex DNA unwinding annotations although I had sometimes applied the parent term  GO:0032392 DNA geometric change
